critique.evidence: The headline and supporting sentence clearly argue for operational metrics over accuracy, and “Compare configurations” provides a visible next action. However, the precision–recall chart appears inconsistent with the stated PR-AUC of 0.958: its line stays near 0% precision for most of the plotted recall range, while the x-axis labeling is incomplete and shows “100%” at the left. The false-positive-cap bars also require readers to map colors to detached values below. Dense, very small labels and the card-style ablation table further reduce mobile legibility. The header supports keyboard navigation, but the mobile/tablet rail hides destinations and relies on the unexplained “SWIPE” cue.
critique.fix: Correct or clarify the precision–recall plot and label both axes with readable ticks; place 88% and 98% directly on their bars; enlarge mobile explanatory and table text; and make the header’s current location and hidden navigation destinations more explicit.
